run_state_estimator_node: run the ROS state estimator node that fuses SLAM and odometry pose data
create_nav_state_estimator: create a NavStateEstimator instance with trust_slam and use_history configuration options
filter_slam_odom_signals: filter and fuse SLAM and odometry signals using a combined low-pass and high-pass approach
publish_filtered_pose: publish the filtered robot pose as a PoseStamped message and TF2 transform
compute_cutoff_angle: compute the cutoff angle from a time duration and cutoff frequency for signal filtering
